notes.title: Additional Language Support
notes.notes: [p]Just a minor update to let you know that Saviour of the Wasteland now supports French, Simplified Chinese, Russian and Portuguese in its subtitles![/p][p]Unfortunately, these are only machine translations, so I cannot guarantee how good they will be and they only apply to the subtitles. Many of the menu items and interface items will still be in English due to the way Ren'py works, but it should make playing much easier for those who speak those languages![/p]

notes.title: Slutty Outfit DLC!
notes.notes:
This was supposed to go live with the game yesterday, but an issue with some artwork caused a delay with Steam approving its release, so it's here a day late!

Anyway, if you wanted to replace the outfits with most of the spicy scenes involving the main character, Alara and Erica, with sluttier ones, now you can!

The DLC is available to purchase here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3625900/Saviour_of_the_Wasteland__Slutty_Outfits/

The screenshots show the outfits they will have. The outfits will become available on the repeatable scenes with each girl, with a couple of exceptions, and you can choose whether you want her to wear the outfit or be nude as normal.

I want to be clear:

[b]This does not add any new content to the game. It only adds outfit options for those already existing scenes.[/b]

Just a tiny patch for a few fixes:

Fixed a bug with the lonelygirl achievement
Fixed a bug with Mia's first animation missing an image
Fixed a bug with a mismatched image on Erica's scene when futa content is turned off
Fixed some spelling errors

notes.title: Saviour of the Wasteland now live!
notes.notes:
It's finally here! I've been working on this game on and off in my spare time for far longer than I care to think about! It started out as a minigame idea for my other project, but quickly ballooned into something way beyond it's original scope. Normally, going way beyond the scope of your idea is a terrible thing to do, as you can easily lose yourself in ideas that'll never come to completion. But, I really enjoyed the story that came out of this, and wanted to make it into something proper.

So, here we are! Saviour of the Wastelands! I'm so glad it's finally available for people to play! I had so much fun making this, coming up with the storylines, adding little easter eggs and references to my other project and how the two tie together! I just hope you enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed making it!

notes.title: June Next Fest
notes.notes:
Good news!

As you may have seen, Steam is hosting another Next Fest in June. If you don't know what Next Fest is, it's a multiday event where upcoming games get promoted and have demos for players to play and discuss. It's a great chance to find some upcoming games that you may otherwise have missed.

I'm happy to say that Saviour of the Wasteland will be one of those games. There'll be a short demo available once the event goes live for you all to try! This is a great chance for you guys to see what I've been working on, as it's very different from Lunar's Chosen, and it also gives me a good opportunity to get feedback on the game from a wider audience.

The event starts on June 10th, so keep an eye out if you want to try it out!

- PTGames
